paragraphs: Chizkiyah and Aivu (see there), sons of Rav's daughter, in Rav's time. Perhaps Shimi was his son. [Glosses: Chizkiyah—Shabbat 112b, “Rabbi Chizkiyah asked.” The word “Rabbi” appears to me a scribal error; not corrected [in the editions].]
